subject.title: fix(msteams): bound Microsoft Graph API response reads in graph-upload to prevent OOM

question: Should MS Teams graph-upload success responses use the shared 16 MiB provider JSON cap and fail closed on larger metadata responses?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and correct, but it intentionally changes shipped success-path behavior for unusually large Graph metadata responses, which is a compatibility tradeoff automation should not accept on its own.

options.title: Accept the shared provider cap
options.body: Land this PR with the existing 16 MiB provider JSON limit as the standard bounded-response policy for graph-upload metadata.

options.title: Require a per-call cap
options.body: Ask for a different documented cap on these Graph upload calls if maintainers know legitimate metadata can exceed the shared provider limit.

recommendation.title: Accept the shared provider cap
recommendation.body: Land this PR with the existing 16 MiB provider JSON limit as the standard bounded-response policy for graph-upload metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` has the strongest history-backed ownership signal for the graph-upload module and its Teams file-delivery behavior.
